description: This Java interface 'EntityFilter' defines a common contract for various entity filtering mechanisms in the Thingsboard platform, including JSON serialization details, discriminator mappings for polymorphic deserialization, and a static method to resolve alias entity IDs within different filter types.

classes.name: EntityFilter
classes.description: Interface for filtering entities with various implementations distinguished by 'type' property, including a static method to resolve alias entity IDs.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the entity filter, used for polymorphic serialization.

methods.name: resolveEntityFilter
methods.description: Static method to resolve alias entity IDs within specific filter instances based on tenant, user, and owner IDs.
